deadline.description: Completed source scoring, producing-stream synchronization and optimum scalar transfer precede timestamp eligibility. At elapsed >=20 seconds, the observer rejects the capture before changing the certified incumbent. Return can overshoot during noninterruptible operations and cleanup.
deadline.kind: strict solution-certification deadline with cooperative return
deadline.natural_return: Already certified incumbent is propagated to remaining checkpoints without additional search or sleep.
deadline.optimum_stop: A reference hit is checked only by independent observer; it stops that trial and is propagated forward. No reference enters solver dynamics.

execution.natural_return: forward-fill without sleep; no additional search or restart
execution.timing: fresh RNG,state,preparation,search,readout and completed certification included

limitations: One dense n200 input; no unseen-QUBO transfer claim.
The24-seed confirmation affects promotion; reported selected-setting observations are selection-affected, not an untouched external test.
Do not pool the two passes or substitute historical100-seed statistics.
Finite-step changes can change periodic readout counts; coupled-population changes can change physical dynamics.
Exchange-cascade graph mode requires memory_limit_bytes=None; capture memory estimates are heuristic, not guaranteed bounds.

precision.dynamics: Per-solver dtype and dynamics_dtype must be preserved.
precision.fresh_state: Every seed resets RNG and creates fresh mutable algorithm state; only input/framework resources are reused.
precision.source_scoring: Original coefficients; exact FP32 accumulation only where the integer-sum bound proves safety, otherwise FP64.

problem.identity_policy: Canonical COO fingerprint must match; differing NPZ container bytes are permitted and their current byte hash must be recorded.
problem.objective: minimize offset + x.T @ symmetric_Q @ x, x in {0,1}^200; upper-triangle off-diagonal entries contribute twice.
problem.reference_provenance: Published Biq Mac optimum; local source normalization preserves minimize x.T Q x.

promotion: Preselected challenger,24freshpairedseeds; exact,1%,mean gap cannot worsen and >=1 must improve
second_pass_baseline: Independently validated first-pass selected settings, including unpromoted retained baselines.
selection: failed trials first; then exact hits descending, within1% descending, mean gap ascending
